display.use: carousel covers, product concept names, big hooks

body.use: readable carousel body text, captions, small labels

layout.cover: large Paquito headline, small subhead, food/product visual, handle, page number
layout.textIntegration: text sits directly in negative space as part of the image composition; avoid filled text blocks, sticker labels, and button-like CTAs
layout.productionOutput: generate clean visual slides without text; provide separate matching text placement guides and exact copy for the user to add manually

imageStyle.references: 1970s hard-flash cookbook documentation and modern pop-art food minimalism
imageStyle.lighting: hard direct flash or direct sun, crisp dark shadows
imageStyle.composition: minimal isolated subject with generous negative space for typography
imageStyle.camera: 50mm to 85mm lens feel, deep focus, extremely sharp edges
imageStyle.realismGate: food must look exactly as if made in reality, with believable texture, colour, viscosity, gloss, portion size, spice flecks, oil sheen, crispness, and ingredient identity
